g.text: localci implementation roadmap
Baseline: CLI scaffold + invoke + serial runner + self-hosting localci:* tasks
Stabilize result model and persisted metadata
Filesystem-backed status reader over current metadata
Persistent queue and in-progress markers
Single-worker scheduler (serial across machine)
Implement postcommit enqueue path
Implement start: idempotent daemon bootstrap
Implement stop: clean daemon shutdown
Unix socket control/status API
Implement status command via daemon API
Add [dir] <commit> [task] filtering and summaries
Localhost HTTP server
Commit and task pages with stdlib templates
Live status and file updates over WebSockets
Implement web command for direct links
Per-task attempt model for retries
Retry command/button for one task attempt
Daemon-side timeout and output activity watcher reuse
Recover partial runs after daemon crash/restart
Enforce modern git and required mise presence
